user_prompt: We need to pull together a comprehensive view of our production risks and costs right now - I want to see both our material expenses broken down by supplier along with any compliance gaps, and at the same time analyze our recent safety incidents and trends across all our manufacturing sites. Can you get me both of those datasets so we can address cost optimization and safety improvements in our next operations review?

steps.step_name: Pull material expenses broken down by supplier to support cost optimization analysis

args.content:
LANDSCAPE SYSTEMS (10 visible):
- workday.hcm: HCM - compensation agents only, NO REST API for staffing data
- sap.sf: SuccessFactors HCM - REST API: EmployeeCompensationManagement:v1 (READ payroll/compensation data)
- sap.s4: ERP - MaterialReceiptInboundAPI (INBOUND REST API for goods receipt/shipment recording), Procurement agents, OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine
- sap.crm: CRM - sales/marketing agents, VendorMaterialProcurementCoordinator agent (AGENT ONLY)
- sap.ehs: Safety/health agents
- sap.ariba: Procurement - PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI (READ/monitor vendor + PO data)
- corp.itsm: IT service mgmt - agents ONLY (NO create API)
- emarsys.cx: CX/marketing - agents only
- my.mes: Manufacturing - ProductionChangeOrchestrator, BillOfMaterialsComplianceValidator
- siemens.plm: PLM - EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning, BOMComplianceValidator
- sap.odm: Data model (entity taxonomy only)

WAREHOUSE RECEIPT MANAGEMENT:
sap.s4:apiResource:MaterialReceiptInboundAPI:v1 - BEST FOR RECORDING INCOMING SHIPMENTS:
  • REST API for creating and managing goods receipt transactions
  • Links received materials to purchase orders
  • Processes supplier shipments at warehouse intake
  • Maintains incoming inventory records

ORGANIZATIONAL HIERARCHY / REPORTING STRUCTURE:
- No dedicated API found in landscape for querying organizational hierarchy or reporting relationships
- workday.hcm & sap.sf have agents that work WITH org hierarchy internally but don't expose it
- sap.sf PerformanceReviewCycleCoordinator creates assignments "based on organizational hierarchy" but this is agent-driven, not a data query API

WORKFORCE SKILLS & ENGINEERING REQUIREMENTS:
sap.sf:agent:SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator:v1 - BEST FOR WORKFORCE SKILLS & PRODUCT TRANSITION:
  • Monitors employee competencies and engineering change requests
  • Coordinates optimal resource allocation for product transition
  • Evaluates capability gaps and recommends development/reassignment actions
  • Processes material & product item requirements across projects
  • Dynamic workforce planning for engineering initiatives

COMPENSATION MANAGEMENT:
sap.sf:agent:CompensationPolicyAutomationEngine:v1 - BEST FOR ALIGNING COMPENSATION WITH NEW ROLES:
  • Automates compensation policy enforcement and salary adjustments
  • Processes compensation events triggered by employee lifecycle transitions
  • Handles performance outcomes and market adjustments
  • Enforces compliance with compensation policies and payroll regulations
  • Natural continuation step after SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator (new roles → compensation alignment)

MATERIAL EXPENSES BY SUPPLIER - NOT FOUND IN LANDSCAPE:
- sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1 provides vendor + PO data (closest operational match)
- BUT landscape lacks dedicated financial expense reporting/analytics API
- Activity requires cost/expense breakdown by supplier (financial analytics capability)
- No BI system, expense management system, or financial reporting module in landscape

args.reason: The landscape lacks a dedicated financial expense reporting or cost analytics API; while PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI provides vendor/PO data, there is no resource that aggregates and reports material expenses broken down by supplier for cost optimization analysis.

result_preview.reason: The landscape lacks a dedicated financial expense reporting or cost analytics API; while PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI provides vendor/PO data, there is no resource that aggregates and reports material expenses broken down by supplier for cost optimization analysis.

method_trace.refuse_reason: The landscape lacks a dedicated financial expense reporting or cost analytics API; while PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI provides vendor/PO data, there is no resource that aggregates and reports material expenses broken down by supplier for cost optimization analysis.
